title: Showing a sight with the index finger is an 18-month social item
summary: By about 18 months, CDC says most children point so a caregiver will look at something interesting.
body: Among social milestones at 18 months, CDC includes pointing to show you something interesting. The gesture shares a sight rather than demanding that an object be handed over. The page's most is its 75-percent-or-more mark, and the materials are not a substitute for a validated screen. A lab of infants already known to point, run near the first birthday, answers a different question and is not this checklist age.
